title: CARIBBEAN FLAGS
ask: Which country does this flag belong to?

questions.fact: No red, white or blue on it at all|💚
A black band edged in white|⬛
A broken trident sits in the middle|🔱
The triangles stand for the twin Pitons|⛰️
